about: Every file of Rouh's code, the one program and bin/ that names the old server's layout, with how many lines do and why that is right in the containers too (rouh/hostguard.py). A new mention fails the check until it is looked at.

bin/rouh-trial.why: tries the containers' /opt/venv first, then the server's venv

one/briefs.py.why: machine_words: the server's sentence where the run has sudo, and the containers' sentence (no systemd, /code read-only, no database) where it does not

one/cli.py.why: the message when the program is not running says the server's way and the containers' way

rouh/base_patches.py.why: a server's default path, which the containers' image overrides with its own environment (deploy/container/Dockerfile.base: ROUH_APP_DIR, ROUH_DATA_DIR, ROUH_TELEGRAM_FILE, ROUH_BREVO_FILE, ROUH_ONE_TOKEN ...)

rouh/case_fixes.py.why: the server's command lines, used only when in_containers() is false; in the containers the brief carries the whole trace and the notes instead

rouh/config.py.why: a server's default path, which the containers' image overrides with its own environment (deploy/container/Dockerfile.base: ROUH_APP_DIR, ROUH_DATA_DIR, ROUH_TELEGRAM_FILE, ROUH_BREVO_FILE, ROUH_ONE_TOKEN ...)

rouh/crew.py.why: the server's background jobs (crew), off in the containers (ROUH_DELEGATE=0), where runs are the one program's
